in_sanskrit.name: Santana
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Born with a sacred mission
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Santana एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Santana means 'one who carries the commandments of God' or 'born with a sacred mission'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sant', which means 'peaceful' or 'holy'. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu traditions and is believed to bring good luck, prosperity, and success.
